# Belt library keys (lane BL step 1, 2026-11-13)

Belt = wijken AA, AB, AC, AD, AE, AF, AG, AH, AJ, AK (69 buurten; AA-AH alone hold 13970 pands), 16152 pands by footprint centroid, of which 14029 face a street or quay (the rest are rear buildings and sheds). Key = crown | bays | storeys | finish | colour. Source order per field: hand > monument > d1 > measured > prior.

Priors: crown and finish by build-year band; bays by front width; storeys by 3DBAG height; colour by buurt; fitted on the pands with a reading (crown 4594, bays 586, storeys 642, finish 718, colour 962), so they carry the bias of which houses got read (monuments for crown). "sampled" draws each unread field from the bucket's read distribution (independent fields, stable per pand id); "mode" gives every unread house of a bucket the same value and is a floor on the key count.
